name: agent-webmcp
title_zh: 网页自己交出工具清单，不再靠截图点按钮
tagline_zh: 以前让 Agent 上网只能截图、找坐标、点按钮，页面一改版就全废。
tagline_en: Stop screenshotting and clicking. Ask the page which WebMCP tools it registered, then call them by name with real.
desc_en: WebMCP tools in the browser: discover page-registered agent tools and invoke them instead of driving the UI. Use when the current page exposes WebMCP tools, when the user asks what an agent can do on a site, or when you need to find a tool-exposing site for a goal (start at webmcp.com). Prefer page tools over screenshots, clicks, and DOM scraping wherever tools exist.
why_zh: 工具由页面自己声明，参数是结构化的，不靠视觉猜坐标。有工具就绝不去点 DOM，页面改样式也不影响调用。
why_en: Tools are declared by the page itself with structured params, so nothing is guessed from pixels. When tools exist, DOM clicking.
limit_zh: 只对主动注册了 WebMCP 工具的站点有效，普通网页它一个工具也发现不了；工具清单和参数由页面说了算。
limit_en: Only works on sites that register WebMCP tools; plain pages expose nothing. The page defines the tool set — no tools means no shortcuts, just a.
title_en: Pages hand over their tool list instead of being clicked
